column1: # Tuneable MDP policy numbers — Q-values and reward weights.
# Change process : Edit in Excel or any spreadsheet tool
#                  commit to Git. No code deployment required.
#   state_id               — must match an id in mdp_config.yaml states
#   optimal_action_id      — must match an id in mdp_config.yaml actions
#   q_value                — expected long-term reward for the optimal action (0–1)
#   reward_policy_adherence      — bonus when chosen action matches optimal action
#   reward_under_treatment       — penalty for insufficiently aggressive action
#   reward_timeliness_bonus      — bonus for completing check within window
#   reward_timeliness_penalty    — penalty for a late check
